Newer navigation has no operational writes
Selecting a different asset cancels the pending cold request
Shared-data completion preserves the newer selected asset
Newer asset request has no runtime errors
Newer asset request has no operational writes
Unverified cold missing reference is not rejected early
Truly unknown reference uses native rejection after shared data is ready
Unknown reference has no runtime errors
Unknown reference has no operational writes
